Thanks again for the demo last week — really excited about getting Redwood listed in our CloudBridge Marketplace later this quarter. Subject: RE: Marketplace addendum — pass-through fee language (redlines attached)

Vanessa / team — I reviewed CloudBridge's v3 and attached a tracked redline with proposed language. Summary of material positions: 

1) Narrow the pass-through definition — allow only "marketplace commission/transaction fees" and applicable taxes enforced by a governmental authority. Exclude any platform surcharge, support fees, or fees for professional services unless expressly enumerated.

2) Billing flow clarity — if CloudBridge is the party of record to end customers, Redwood will accept a line-item pass-through so long as CloudBridge provides monthly statements reconciled to invoices and a right to dispute within 60 days. If Redwood issues the invoice, pass-through must be reflected as a separate line item and credited/charged only once.

3) Indemnity and cap — decline a broad indemnity tied to pass-through; propose a mutual indemnity limited to third-party IP claims and a monetary cap for pass-through disputes equal to the aggregate pass-through amounts in the prior 3 months.

4) Audit / reconciliation — agree to quarterly reconciliation but limit to one operational review per quarter, with confidentiality and scope limitations (no customer PII required).

I've attached: CloudBridge_Marketplace_Addendum_v3_redlines.docx (Markus_redlines). Please review and advise whether we should push for any additional protections (e.g., holdback mechanics or escrow for disputed amounts).

Markus Klein
Senior Counsel | Redwood Inference
